summary.zh: 先拿 5% 冰霜与火焰命中，再用霜寒刺骨制造冰冻，20 级用冰枪术兑现。
summary.en: 5% hit with Frost and Fire first, Frostbite for freezes, and Ice Lance at 20 to punish them.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，主用寒冰箭，20 级接上冰枪术
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, Frostbolt with Ice Lance at 20

pros.zh: 元素精准提供 5% 冰霜与火焰命中；一次被抵抗的寒冰箭，损失超过这里任何一个天赋带来的收益。
pros.en: Elemental Precision adds 5% hit with Frost and Fire spells; a resisted Frostbolt costs you more than any other talent here adds.

pros.zh: 霜寒刺骨让你的减速效果有 15% 几率将目标冰冻 5 秒。
pros.en: Frostbite gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to freeze the target for 5 seconds.

pros.zh: 冰枪术对被冰冻的目标伤害提高 300%，正好承接霜寒刺骨的触发。
pros.en: Ice Lance deals 300% increased damage to frozen targets, which pairs directly with those Frostbite procs.

pros.zh: 寒冰碎片是可调整的 2 点；如果挨打比预期多，冰霜障壁或强化冰霜新星都是合理选择。
pros.en: Ice Shards holds the flexible pair of points; Frost Warding or Improved Frost Nova are reasonable if you are taking more damage than you expect.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
